Package org.ddolib.layered.solving.ddo.core.mdd

package org.ddolib.layered.solving.ddo.core.mdd
This package contains LinkedDecisionDiagram, the layered implementation of the shared DecisionDiagram abstraction: a restricted/relaxed MDD compiled layer by layer, together with the Node/Edge/NodeSubProblem classes it is built from.
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    org.ddolib.layered.solving.ddo.core
    This package contains the core classes and interfaces that are central to the implementation of an optimization solver based on branch and bound with decision diagrams.
    org.ddolib.layered.solving.ddo.core.compilation
    This package contains CompilationConfig, which bundles everything needed to compile a layered decision diagram (the CompilationType, dominance checker, cache, cut-set type, clustering strategy, variable heuristic and modeling pieces).
    org.ddolib.layered.solving.ddo.core.solver
    This package contains solvers using the DDO (Branch-and-Bound with decision diagrams) algorithm for the layered API: SequentialSolver (full DDO with relaxed and restricted MDDs), ExactSolver (exact MDD only), and RelaxationSolver / RestrictionSolver (a single relaxed/restricted MDD, mainly used internally and for testing bounds).
  • Class
    Description
    Edge
    Represents an edge in a decision diagram that connects two nodes.
    LinkedDecisionDiagram<T>
    This class implements a decision diagram as a linked structure (linked MDD).
    Node
    Represents an atomic node in a decision diagram.
    NodeSubProblem<T>
    Encapsulates the association of a node in a decision diagram with its corresponding state and an associated rough lower bound.
    NodeSubProblemComparator<T>
    Comparator for NodeSubProblem instances that sorts them first by their node value, and then by the state using a provided StateRanking if the values are equal.
    NodeType
    Enum representing the different types of nodes in the decision diagram.
